div.head: Hn com 2.1
div.ab: Ego enim, quando voluero, faciam ea satis summonere propter mea dominica necessaria ad voluntatem meam.
For I, when I so desire, shall have them summoned, in accordance with my will, a sufficient number of times, in order to transact the business pertaining to the crown.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added
